title: Rights That Cannot Be Taken Away
goal: I can say that rights belong to everyone and cannot be taken away (*elidegeníthetetlen*).
I can use *olyan …, amelyek mint ilyenek …* in a solemn sentence.
I can name rights that cannot be limited (*korlátozhatatlan*).

sections.title: Unit 11: Human Rights, Minority Protections & International Law
body: This unit is about human rights: rights that cannot be taken away, national minorities, war crimes, international treaties in Hungarian law, and guilt and responsibility.
The reading in lesson 5 is a text about the political thinker Bibó István.

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say that rights belong to everyone and cannot be taken away (*elidegeníthetetlen*).
I can use *olyan …, amelyek mint ilyenek …* in a solemn sentence.
I can name rights that cannot be limited (*korlátozhatatlan*).
